legendListNote: Consume the original published @legendapp/list 3.3.5 package. The T3 pnpm patch set is not applied. This slice does not configure anchoredEndSpace or inline calc scroll padding; do not assume those patched features are available.
hostIntegrationOwnership: These files are XGC-owned composition, native-protocol mapping, callback authority, host identities and style-build adapters. They are not upstream T3 Code components.

nativeProtocolOwnership.note: The shared native state, transport and request-answer contract are owned by XGC. This presentation migration does not import the T3 Code server or its Codex app-server client.

styleIntegration.selectorScope: .xgc-native-chat via native CSS @scope; no unsupported-browser fallback is provided
styleIntegration.reset: Tailwind preflight is included inside the chat scope. It is not installed as a global page reset, and it also applies to custom timeline slots inside that scope.
styleIntegration.globalRegistrations: CSS @property and keyframes registrations remain global and are renamed with --xgc-t3- / xgc-t3- prefixes.
hostRequirements: XGC semantic CSS tokens and fonts
styleIntegration.boundary: CSS selector scoping is not Shadow DOM isolation. Host inheritance and domain content rendered inside the scope remain part of the integration contract. Native capsule roots do not create stacking isolation: their existing portal layer must remain interactive above later sibling capsules. A single-row controls layout gives the model flexible width, preserves effort text and uses the existing permission-state icon in a narrow row with full accessible/tooltip/menu text. The size container stays on the controls row, outside its portal siblings.
styleIntegration.adaptations: Host aliases include colors, fonts, scrollbars, radius, glass values and container sizing; they are not color-only changes. Main upstream geometry is retained without promising pixel equivalence to every upstream theme.

additionalUpstreamConstants.themeDifference: The host adapter uses the upstream default glass values and does not reproduce the upstream dark overrides at lines 120-121.

consumerContract.runtime: React 19 peers; ESM package exports. TypeScript typesVersions support older resolver modes but do not supply a CommonJS require build.
consumerContract.presentation: Research and GCS use one shared conversation and request surface. Domain business content is accepted through custom timeline slots, not by importing host business logic into the shared package.
consumerContract.callbacks: Send, request answer, request cancellation and whole-turn interruption remain distinct real callbacks. Submitted requests stay locked pending native resolution. Missing send/interrupt capabilities do not create placeholder operation controls.
consumerContract.drafts: Controlled drafts are retained on send failure and are cleared on success only if unchanged; host domains own session-specific persistence and idempotency.
consumerContract.ssr: The virtualized timeline renders an unmeasured viewport on the server; message rows appear after browser measurement. ESM/SSR import support is not full server rendering of the message history.
consumerContract.localization: locale=zh localizes selected mapper labels. Upstream Composer, request actions and other controls still use English. NativeInput does not currently consume its locale prop. New NativeProviderSettings and NativeComposerControls support en/zh for fixed UI labels; native capability labels/IDs are not translated.
consumerContract.toolPresentation: Structured command, file-change and MCP fields have selected presentation support. commandActions and webSearch details can be retained in native state without a dedicated rich view. This is not complete T3 Code or Codex protocol UI coverage.
consumerContract.history: Missing timestamps are not manufactured. Partial payloads are marked; historical free-form answers are not reconstructed from submission/resolution events.
consumerContract.providerSettings: NativeProviderSettings accepts the decoded settings document plus explicit onSave(update) and onRefresh(profileId) callbacks. Shared whitelist exposes enabled, CLI path and verified default model/effort/permission fields. Draft revisions are captured at the first edit and preserved across refreshes and failures. No authentication credentials or environment configuration.
consumerContract.composerOptions: NativeComposerControls accepts provider capabilities, a controlled NativeComposerSelection and an onChange callback. Selection changes only host draft state; NativeConversation accepts a composerControls slot. Exact options are passed by the host as the fourth sendNativePrompt argument or Scope.options at create. Cross-provider selection does not copy previous permissions or effort. No session/project/Git management UI. Optional identityId scopes annotation roles when multiple real controls share a provider.
